protocol.experiment: Fixed C basis and tail objective with write-time risk protection
protocol.supervision: tail-4-token autoregressive CE of the window's own dropped-block fact lines under the candidate pool; no QA answer ever enters a gradient step
protocol.basis: frozen C damaged-fact gradient SVD-13 from identical cached rows
protocol.selection_rule: windows picked on stage-1 coverage (best/worst gRho), not QA
protocol.metrics: new_recovery = full∧¬d0∧trained; d0_harmed = d0∧full harmed; net = new_recovery - d0_harmed; both teacher-forced exact and greedy-generation EM recorded
protocol.reader_evaluation: eval; exact mixed-mode and RNG restoration; full-memory integrity check
protocol.arm_definition: new damaged-fact gradient 13D basis + old tail-4-token CE
protocol.supervision_leakage: raw write-time fact statements only; benchmark QA is evaluation-only
protocol.protection: top20 kept facts by descending eligible D0 CE; lambda=1 mean hinge
protocol.training_fact_cap: unchanged C tail pool <=40 plus <=20 kept protection facts

risk_protection.name: C_risk_v1
risk_protection.selection: kept latest-owner facts; finite 0<=D0 CE<=2; descending D0 CE then key; top20
risk_protection.objective: sum tail-4 CE + 1.0 * mean ReLU(kept fact answer CE - D0 CE)
